system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hello, yes, bonjour. I want to cancel all my upcoming flights, s’il vous plaît.

My name is Amelia Davis, and my user id is **amelia_davis_8890**.

I do not know the reservation numbers, désolée. But even if some flights are not refundable, I still want to cancel all of them, yes? I prefer to give the seat to someone else who needs it.

I found your reservations and checked which ones are still upcoming.

Eligible for cancellation now:
- 8C8K4E — BOS to DEN on 2024-05-24, business, 2 passengers, insurance: yes
- UDMOP1 — upcoming flights on 2024-05-28 and 2024-05-29, basic economy, 1 passenger, insurance: no
- XAZ3C0 — ATL to CLT on 2024-05-27, basic economy, 2 passengers, insurance: no
- LU15PA — SFO to SFO on 2024-05-23, business, 2 passengers, insurance: no
- MSJ4OA — DFW to SFO on 2024-05-22, economy, 3 passengers, insurance: yes
- 4XGCCM — airline-cancelled reservation, round trip, business, 1 passenger, insurance: yes

Not eligible for self-service cancellation here:
- I6M8JQ — flight on 2024-05-09 has already been flown

Before I proceed, please confirm:
1. You want me to cancel these 6 reservations: 8C8K4E, UDMOP1, XAZ3C0, LU15PA, MSJ4OA, and 4XGCCM
2. The reason for cancellation for the upcoming reservations is one of these:
   - change of plan
   - airline cancelled flight
   - other reasons

You can reply like:
- “Yes, cancel all 6. Reason: change of plan.”

For I6M8JQ, because part of the trip has already been flown, I would need to transfer you to a human agent if you want help with that reservation.

Yes, please cancel all 6: **8C8K4E, UDMOP1, XAZ3C0, LU15PA, MSJ4OA, and 4XGCCM**.

Reason: **other reasons**.

Even if some are non-refundable, c’est bon, I still want to cancel them all. For **I6M8JQ**, no need for transfer. I only want to cancel the upcoming ones.

Your 6 reservations have been cancelled:

- 8C8K4E
- UDMOP1
- XAZ3C0
- LU15PA
- MSJ4OA
- 4XGCCM

Refunds:
- Refunds will go back to the original payment methods on file.
- Processing time is 5 to 7 business days.

I did not take any action on I6M8JQ, as requested.

Thank you very much, merci.

So all 6 upcoming reservations are cancelled, yes? That is perfect. I understand about the refunds, 5 to 7 business days.

And yes, no action for **I6M8JQ**. Thank you for your help today.

Yes — all 6 upcoming reservations are cancelled, and no action was taken on I6M8JQ.

You’re welcome.
Great, merci beaucoup. Have a good day.
